class FenwickTree:
    def __init__(self, size):
        # size represents the maximum value + 1, so indices are 0 to size-1
        self.bit = [0] * (size + 1)
        self.size = size

    def update(self, index, delta): # index is 0-based value
        index += 1 # Convert to 1-based for BIT
        while index <= self.size:
            self.bit[index] += delta
            index += index & (-index)

    def query(self, index): # Sum up to index (0-based)
        index += 1 # Convert to 1-based for BIT
        res = 0
        while index > 0:
            res += self.bit[index]
            index -= index & (-index)
        return res

    def query_range(self, start_idx, end_idx):
        if start_idx > end_idx:
            return 0
        return self.query(end_idx) - self.query(start_idx - 1)

class FenwickTree:

    def __init__(self, size):
        self.bit = [0] * (size + 1)
        self.size = size

    def update(self, index, delta):
        index += 1
        while index <= self.size:
            self.bit[index] += delta
            index += index & -index

    def query(self, index):
        index += 1
        res = 0
        while index > 0:
            res += self.bit[index]
            index -= index & -index
        return res

    def query_range(self, start_idx, end_idx):
        if start_idx > end_idx:
            return 0
        return self.query(end_idx) - self.query(start_idx - 1)

            if colors[i] != colors[(i + 1) % N]:
                is_alternating[i] = 1
            else:
                is_alternating[i] = 0
        ft_counts = FenwickTree(N + 1)
        ft_sums = FenwickTree(N + 1)
        zero_indices = SortedList()
        for i in range(N):
            if is_alternating[i] == 0:
                zero_indices.add(i)

        def update_block_len(L, delta):
            if L <= 0:
                return
            ft_counts.update(L, delta)
            ft_sums.update(L, delta * L)
        if not zero_indices:
            update_block_len(N, 1)
        else:
            for i in range(len(zero_indices)):
                z_prev = zero_indices[i - 1]
                z_curr = zero_indices[i]
                length = (z_curr - z_prev - 1 + N) // N
                update_block_len(length, 1)
        results = []
        for query in queries:
            query_type = query[0]

                results.append(ans)

                if colors[index_i] == color_i:

                for current_idx in indices_to_check:
                    new_val = 1 if colors[current_idx] != colors[(current_idx + 1) % N] else 0

                            if L_merged > 0:
                                update_block_len(L_merged, 1)
                        zero_indices.remove(current_idx)
                    else:
                        if not zero_indices:
                            update_block_len(N, -1)
                            update_block_len(N - 1, 1)
                        else:
                            idx_for_insert = zero_indices.bisect_left(current_idx)
                            z_prev = zero_indices[idx_for_insert - 1]

                                update_block_len(L1_new, 1)

                        zero_indices.add(current_idx)
